definitions.gloss: heat-resistant; heatproof; able to withstand high temperatures
definitions.explanation: The property of being able to endure high temperatures without damage, deformation, or loss of function. Used for materials, containers, and products designed to resist heat.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ボウル→ボウル：04483_bouru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐熱|たいねつ}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{電子|でんし}レンジ→電子レンジ：04973_denshirenji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This bowl is heat-resistant, so it can be used in the microwave.

examples.english: The heat-resistant temperature is up to 200 degrees.

notes:
A technical modifier meaning "heat-resistant." Functions as a prefix-like noun that modifies the following noun. Very common in product descriptions, cooking instructions, and materials science.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐熱|たいねつ}⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧: heat-resistant glass (Pyrex-type)
- {耐熱|たいねつ}⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧: heat-resistant container
- {耐熱|たいねつ}⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧: heat-resistance temperature
- {耐熱|たいねつ}⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: heat-resistant material
- {耐熱|たいねつ}⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧: heat-resistant dish

FORMS:
Built with the prefix {耐|たい}〜 (resistance to ~), which combines with many nouns:
- ⟦{耐水|たいすい}→耐水：24232_taisui⟧: water-resistant
- ⟦{耐震|たいしん}→耐震：06222_taishin⟧: earthquake-resistant
- ⟦{耐久|たいきゅう}→耐久：18768_taikyuu⟧: durable, long-lasting

USAGE:
Commonly seen on product labels and in recipe instructions. {耐熱|たいねつ}⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦レンジ→レンジ：01047_renji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧ (put in a heat-resistant container and microwave) is a standard instruction.
